name: Quiz 2.3: Test Your Understanding of RACI Charts

questions.statement: 1. According to the RACI framework, what is the critical rule about the "Accountable" role?

options.value: Multiple people should share accountability to ensure nothing is missed
The accountable person must also be the one doing the work
There should be only ONE accountable person for each task
Accountability can be delegated to external contractors
The accountable person should never be consulted during the process

questions.statement: 2. How does RACI help identify opportunities for AI integration in business processes?

options.value: It eliminates the need for human involvement in all processes
It provides a framework to understand who does what, making it easier to identify which elements AI could take over
It automatically assigns AI to all Responsible roles
It prevents AI from being used in any Accountable positions
It requires all Consulted roles to be replaced by AI

questions.statement: 3. According to the lesson, what should you do if a process doesn't currently exist in your organization but represents a gap that needs to be filled soon?

options.value: Mark it as "N/A"
Ignore it until you're ready to implement it
Mark it as "Future"
Assign multiple people as accountable immediately
Remove it from your process documentation

questions.statement: 4. What is one of the main business problems that RACI helps to solve?

options.value: Reducing employee salaries
Eliminating the need for process documentation
Reducing the number of meetings required
Automating all business processes
Tasks falling through the cracks because people thought someone else was handling them

questions.statement: 5. Based on the instructor note, which RACI category will be de-emphasized in this program?

options.value: Responsible
Accountable
Consulted
Informed
All categories will be equally emphasized
